info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Healthcare Appointments Checkin-v1-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Check-in API facilitates the process of patient check-ins for scheduled healthcare appointments. This endpoint allows healthcare providers to confirm a patient's arrival and update their status in the scheduling system. Typical consumers of this API include healthcare facilities, clinics, and telehealth platforms that aim to streamline appointment management. By integrating this functionality, organizations can enhance patient flow and ensure timely care delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to check in for their scheduled appointments. Upon successful check-in, the appointment status will be updated accordingly, allowing the staff to prepare for the patient's arrival.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to check in an appointment. It requires the necessary details to identify the appointment and the individual checking in. Please ensure that all required fields are provided.

200.description: Check-in completed successfully and appointment details returned.
